title: aurit.us example pages drive acceptance
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Website examples
  Scenario: Example page embeds the player
    Given the site is deployed at aurit.us
    When a visitor opens an example page
    Then the Auritus player mounts with themed styles
    And acceptance tests can drive generation end-to-end
```

## Implementation brief
1. site/ Next.js: landing, docs (usage, ignore rules, theming, self-hosting), example pages.
2. Amplify Hosting; custom domain via existing Route 53 zone.
3. Acceptance suite against examples.
right_now_summary: The aurit.us site is being built with themed player examples for end-to-end acceptance tests.
